text.p: CopyTele Inc said Tuesday it has entered into three distribution agreements for the sale and service of its Magicom 2000 product expected to generate sales of $90 million of the next three years.

These agreements, for terms of three years, provide for the purchase of the distributors' requirements of Magicom 2000 units for sale in the designated territories, CopyTele explained. The agreements provide for monthly purchase orders in increasing quantities starting in the first quarter of 1997 to be accompanied by irrevocable bank letters of credit furnished by the distributors.
In North Africa, CopyTele said, it entered into an agreement with a consortium of companies in Tunisia whose territory includes the countries of Tunisia, Algeria and Morocco.

In Egypt, CopyTele entered into agreements with two distributors that provide sales and service to telecommunications customers in the public and private sectors. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
